name: Blockade Breaker
_: Region 1's boss (owner decision H, 2026-10-04): the layered fortress Blockade Breaker of docs/boss-concepts.md, style 1. Two layers: the armour plates ARE the hull's lower face (layer 1, rows 3-7); four pulse cannons and the emitter slot sit recessed behind them in the deep layer (rows 1-3). gun-2 sits in an open bay and fires from the first frame; the others open fire once their plates fall. The emitter slot is capped armour until the lasers exist (S4b). The boss falls with its last weapon; armour left standing is not required. Placeholder art drawn by the agent (decision G); the owner retouches the PNGs. A destroyed module disappears (owner decision L): its top cavityRows rows, inside the hull, become a plain cavity, the rows below it band background - every plate hangs below the hull (0), the cannons and the emitter sit inside it. docs/level-authoring.md, 'The boss', is the format; plan §5.15 the design. Hit points: Q-B3's start values adjusted for the 45-60 s MEDIUM target (decision I) - plates by size 6 / 8 / 10, cannons 14 (plan §5.15: the model's 12 gave a MEASURED 42.8-s MEDIUM fight; 14 is the next step, plan §5.15.7); scores packed BCD.

palette._: COLPF0 light steel (the plates' face), COLPF1 mid grey (bevels, trim), COLPF2 amber (cannons, lights, damage glow, sparks, flames), COLPF3 dark burgundy (the hull's bulk). flashLuma: the one-frame band flash adds this to each luminance; every colour stays inside its hue (+4 at most to $0E).

motion._: The band drifts one colour clock every framesPerColourClock frames across travelColourClocks and back (plan §5.2): the window shows band columns 0-55 over the travel, so both engine ends come into view in turn; the win shakes it by HSCROL jitter (Q-S5).

chain._: The win: blasts along every module, the surviving armour included (§5.13.2 item 10).

fire._: One countdown (§5.13.2 item 6): the next armed cannon fires when it reaches 0 and the countdown restarts from that cannon's reload (EASY +1/2, HARD -1/4), never under this cooldown. gun-2's slower reload opens the fight; the faster cannons behind the plates raise the rate as they are exposed.

capped._: An emitter slot the level does not enable - every slot until the lasers exist (S4b) - becomes armour with the capped plate (extras.png) and these hit points.

nozzles._: The engine nozzles at both ends (decision K): the cells that show the left and the right nozzle glyph; their three phases (extras.png) cycle every framesPerPhase frames and go dark on the win's first blast.
